body: Owner ask: can the React UI be used with any other API or a custom client? Split every registry/auth component into a pure View (props in, events out) plus the wired component (unchanged name and props), enforce with a source-scanning vitest, write docs/client/custom-backend.md with type-checked examples. Branch react-split.
title: React kit: split registry components into pure views and wired components, guard test, custom-backend guide
